# Ritekit

RiteKit offers a suite of APIs designed to enhance social media engagement by providing tools for hashtag generation, link shortening, and content analysis.

Category: Marketing. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/ritekit/.

## Actions

- **Auto Hashtag** (read-only): Automatically add relevant hashtags to a given post.
- **Auto Hashtag** (read-only): Automatically add relevant hashtags to a given post.
- **Check Banned Instagram Hashtags** (read-only): Identify which hashtags are banned on instagram.
- **Convert Text to Image**: Convert a quote into a styled image.
- **Delete Link Ad**: Delete a link ad.
- **Disposable Email Detection** (read-only): Detect if an email address is disposable.
- **Free Email Detection** (read-only): Detect whether an email address belongs to a free email provider.
- **List Link Ads** (read-only): Retrieve a list of link ads.
- **RiteKit Hashtag Stats** (read-only): Retrieve real-time engagement stats for up to 100 hashtags.
- **RiteKit Hashtag Suggestions** (read-only): Get hashtag suggestions for a given text.
- **Shorten Link**: Shorten a url with a specified cta.
- **Get Access Token**: Obtain a ritekit access token.
- **RiteKit Get Access Token**: Fetch a ritekit oauth2 access token using client credentials.
- **RiteKit Get Client ID**: Retrieve stored ritekit client id.
- **RiteKit Get Client Secret**: Retrieve stored ritekit client secret.
